name: Deep Core Mining Helper
author: CMDR Example
description: Surfaces EDFM mining pages when you prospect an asteroid or dock somewhere with a Material Trader.
instructions:
This plugin stays quiet until one of two things happens in game.

Deep core asteroid:
  Fire a prospector limpet at an asteroid. If it has a core, the
  context appears for four minutes with links to the mining pages.
  Ordinary asteroids will not trigger it.

Material Trader:
  Dock at any station that has a Material Trader. The context stays
  for fifteen minutes.

Both appear on the Context screen and in the overlay. If you have
not seen either yet, nothing is wrong -- you have not been in a
situation that matches.

contextRules.title: Deep core asteroid
contextRules.subtitle: You prospected an asteroid with a core
